mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(XX.SCH_CODE),0) FROM ( SELECT X.SCH_CODE, X.CON_UPDATECHECK FROM ( SELECT A.SCH_CODE, A.CON_UPDATECHECK FROM TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY A, TB_SCHEDULE B, TB_DIDINFO C WHERE A.SCH_CODE = B.SCH_CODE AND A.DID_ID = C.DID_ID AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') >= B.SCH_STARTDAY AND B.SCH_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND B.SCH_USEYN = 'Y' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(C.DID_MAC) = #{didMacAddress} AND A.DID_UPDATECHECK = 'N' ORDER BY ( CASE b.SCH_EMERGUBUN WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END ) ASC , A.HIS_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) X ) XX WHERE XX.CON_UPDATECHECK = 'N'

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(A.MSG_SEQ),0) FROM TB_MESSAGEHISTORY A , TB_SENDMESSAGETYPR B WHERE A.XML_PROCESS_NAME = B.XML_PROCESS_NAME AND B.WORK_GUBUN = 'WORKGUBUN02' AND A.SEND_RESULT = 'N' AND A.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(A.DID_MACADDRESS) = #{didMacAddress}

SELECT A.MSG_SEQ AS msgSeq, A.XML_PROCESS_NAME AS xmlProcessName, A.SEND_REGDATE AS sendRegdate, A.SEND_RESULT AS sendResult FROM TB_MESSAGEHISTORY A, TB_SENDMESSAGETYPR B WHERE A.XML_PROCESS_NAME = B.XML_PROCESS_NAME AND B.WORK_GUBUN = 'WORKGUBUN02' AND A.SEND_RESULT = 'N' AND A.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(A.DID_MACADDRESS) = #{didMacAddress} ORDER BY MSG_SEQ ASC
SELECT MSG_SEQ FROM TB_MESSAGEHISTORY WHERE SEND_DIDID = #{sendDidId} ORDER BY MSG_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO TB_MESSAGEHISTORY ( MSG_SEQ, DID_ID, XML_PROCESS_NAME, SEND_RESULT, SEND_REGDATE, DID_MACADDRESS, ERROR_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{msgSeq}, #{didId}, #{xmlProcessName}, #{sendResult}, NOW(), #{didMacAddress}, #{errorMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
